thread:
Maria: Thanks everyone for the postmortem notes earlier. Quick follow-up — we need clear owners and a small checklist to update the triage procedures and escalation path. Can each team pick an owner and a due date by EOD tomorrow?
Alex: I'll take the triage checklist and the quick commands section.
Tara: I'll own escalation paths (who to page, when to escalate to infra). Due EOD Wed for a first draft.
Kevin: I'll do the KV cache and eviction diagnostics section + add the specific metrics to monitor. Can we set a due date of Friday?
Maria: Great. Alex — add exact commands we used during the incident (kubectl, redis-cli, curl) and a short snippet for rolling service restart.
Alex: Will do. Proposed commands:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
kubectl logs -f deploy/inference-worker -c runtime
redis-cli -h inference-redis INFO
```
I'll include notes about when to use `--grace-period` vs drain.
SRE-Bot: Jira ticket created: INF-3127 "Standardize triage procedures after cache-related outage" assigned to Alex/Tara/Kevin. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3127
Tara: For escalation, I'll add a short matrix: severity -> who paged -> page group -> escalation interval. Example: Sev1 -> oncall infra -> pager #infra -> escalate to exec after 30m.
Kevin: I'll add the Grafana dashboards and exact panel links to the runbook. Also adding alert thresholds we triggered: CPU>85% sustained 5m, KV cache miss rate >15%.
Maria: Also add a short section for recurring patterns we saw: cache fragmentation after long tail requests, bursty load on embedding endpoints. Recommend adding a weekly review chore to playbook: "incident-patterns-review".
Alex: I'll push a PR to the runbooks repo and tag @Tara and @Kevin for review. PR description will include a link back to the postmortem notes and the replay steps.
Tara: Can someone from Platform review the escalation matrix for on-call load balancing? cc @Kevin
Kevin: I'll ask Platform to review, pinging them now.
Jira-Bot: INF-3127 updated: subtasks added - triage-checklist (Alex), escalation-matrix (Tara), dashboards-and-thresholds (Kevin). Due dates: Alex: 3 days, Tara: 5 days, Kevin: 7 days.
Maria: Perfect. Let's reconvene in 1 week on the follow-ups channel to confirm PRs merged and runbook updates deployed. Thanks :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks — will send PR link asap.
Tara: On it.
Kevin: Got it.
